addMilestone(uint256,string,uint256).details: The sum of all milestone amounts must not exceed the campaign target.

params.amount: USDC allocation for this milestone (base units).

approveMilestone(uint256,uint256).details: ONLY the reviewer address may call this. Evidence submission alone         does not trigger approval — this explicit call is required.         Advances status Completed → Approved.

cancelCampaign(uint256).details: After cancellation contributors may call claimRefund().         No new contributions or milestones are accepted.         Cancellation is BLOCKED when any milestone is in Approved status.         Reason: releaseMilestone requires active=true, so an Approved milestone         on a cancelled campaign is permanently un-releasable, and because a         payout has been earmarked, contributors who contributed less than the         milestone amount may not be fully refundable. The organizer must either:         (a) release all Approved milestones first, or         (b) ask the reviewer to revokeApproval before cancelling.

claimRefund(uint256).details: Only callable when the campaign is inactive (cancelled).         Zeroes the contributor's record before transferring to prevent double-refund.         Uses checks-effects-interactions and nonReentrant guard.         Does NOT refund contributions that were already consumed by a milestone         payout — campaignBalance accounts for payouts automatically.         Cross-campaign isolation: only `campaignBalance[campaignId]` is touched;         no other campaign's balance can be spent here.

params.usdcTokenAddress: Address of the USDC ERC-20 token (6 decimals on Arc).

contribute(uint256,uint256).details: Caller must have approved this contract for at least `amount` USDC.         Uses checks-effects-interactions: state is updated before safeTransferFrom.

params.recipient: Address that receives released milestone payouts.
params.target: Total campaign target in USDC base units (1 USDC = 1_000_000).

markMilestoneComplete(uint256,uint256).details: Advances status InProgress → Completed. Only organizer may call.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

releaseMilestone(uint256,uint256).details: Requires: milestone.status == Approved, !milestone.paid,         campaignBalance[id] >= milestone.amount.         Uses checks-effects-interactions: all state updated before safeTransfer.         nonReentrant guard applied.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

revokeApproval(uint256,uint256).details: Only the reviewer may call this. Intended as a remediation path when         the recipient address becomes blocklisted or otherwise unreachable after         approval: the reviewer revokes, the organizer calls updateRecipient         (now allowed since no milestone is Approved), then marks complete again         if needed, and the reviewer re-approves.         This does NOT revert status further than Approved → Completed.

setReviewer(address).details: The owner cannot touch campaign funds. Only this function and the         inherited renounceOwnership / transferOwnership are available to owner.         For production, use a multi-sig as the reviewer to avoid single-key risk.

submitEvidence(uint256,uint256,string).details: Recording evidence does NOT change milestone status.         Only the reviewer can advance status to Approved.

params.evidenceURI: Off-chain link (e.g. IPFS CID) to supporting evidence.
params.milestoneIndex: Index of the milestone within the campaign.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

updateRecipient(uint256,address).details: Blocked when any milestone is in Approved status to prevent a         malicious organizer from redirecting an imminent approved payout.         Allowed on inactive campaigns that still hold a balance, so         organisers can remediate a blocklisted recipient after cancellation.

params.newRecipient: New address to receive future milestone payouts.

MAX_MILESTONES().notice: Maximum number of milestones allowed per campaign.

addMilestone(uint256,string,uint256).notice: Adds a milestone to an active campaign.

approveMilestone(uint256,uint256).notice: Approves a completed milestone, authorising its payout.

campaignBalance(uint256).notice: Live USDC balance attributed to each campaign.

campaigns(uint256).notice: Campaign data keyed by campaign ID.

claimRefund(uint256).notice: Returns a contributor's full contribution to a cancelled campaign.

contribute(uint256,uint256).notice: Contributes USDC to an active campaign.

markMilestoneComplete(uint256,uint256).notice: Signals that a milestone's work is done and ready for reviewer inspection.

nextCampaignId().notice: Auto-incrementing campaign counter; also the next campaign ID.

releaseMilestone(uint256,uint256).notice: Releases approved milestone funds to the campaign recipient.

reviewer().notice: Address authorised to approve milestones. Changeable by owner only.

revokeApproval(uint256,uint256).notice: Revokes a milestone's Approved status, returning it to Completed.

submitEvidence(uint256,uint256,string).notice: Attaches or updates off-chain evidence for a milestone.

usdcToken().notice: The USDC token this contract accepts. Immutable after deployment.
